summary: Restored workstation and public-edge reachability for the three running project-management tools by changing Focalboard, Kan, and Planka Docker port bindings from loopback-only to externally reachable VM bindings, then recreating only those compose services.

verification.observed: Nginx logged upstream connection timeouts to 10.10.10.20:8111, :8113, and :8116 while the containers were published only as 127.0.0.1:<port> on docker-runtime-lv3.
`docker ps` now reports focalboard on 0.0.0.0:8111->8000, kan on 0.0.0.0:8113->3000, and planka on 0.0.0.0:8116->1337.
From the workstation, Planka returned HTTP 200, Focalboard returned HTTP 200, and Kan returned HTTP 307 with redirect https://kan.0mcp.com/login.
The other seven PM tools still have public Nginx routes but no running backend listeners; they remain deployment-completion work for ws-pm-tools-deploy.

notes: The live mutation was intentionally narrow: only the three already-running stacks were recreated.
The template changes prevent the next converge from reverting the working edge reachability fix.
